email_subject: Application - Social Media Intern at team.blue
email_body:
Dear team.blue Hiring Team,

I'm applying for the Social Media Intern role. Your focus on turning corporate messages into engaging LinkedIn and Instagram content immediately caught my attention. I'm fluent in English, confident with Canva, and regularly use AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT for content drafting and research. I've built and managed websites in WordPress, created visuals in Canva, and written SEO content that ranks. I'm very familiar with LinkedIn and Instagram, and I enjoy experimenting with short-form formats like reels and carousels. I'm curious, trend-aware, and comfortable working independently, but I also know when to ask for guidance. I'd love to bring my content and design skills to your Corporate Communications team and learn from your Social Media Manager.

Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear team.blue Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Social Media Intern position. Your description of translating corporate messages into attractive, engaging social media content resonates with my own approach to digital communication. I'm fluent in English, confident with Canva for design and templates, and I regularly use AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT for content drafting and research. I'm also very familiar with LinkedIn and Instagram, and I enjoy experimenting with short-form formats such as reels and carousels.

In my current freelance work and as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I create and manage content for client websites, including blog posts, landing pages, and social media integration. I've built and optimized multiple WordPress sites, designed visuals in Canva, and written clear, punchy copy that ranks in search. My technical background in front-end development and SEO gives me a solid understanding of how content performs across channels. I'm comfortable working independently, but I also value mentorship and know when to ask for guidance.

What excites me about team.blue is the opportunity to work within an international Corporate Communications team, focusing on social media while getting exposure to PR, podcast production, and events. I'm curious, trend-aware, and full of ideas for new content formats. I'm eager to bring my skills to your social media campaigns and learn from your Social Media Manager.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to team.blue's social community and brand awareness.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
